entities.summary: The Diocese of Ambanja is a Latin Church diocese of the Catholic Church. Located in the city of Ambanja, it is a suffragan diocese in the ecclesiastical province of the Metropolitan Archdiocese of Antsiranana in Madagascar. Its episcopal see is the Cathedral of Saint Joseph, which was constructed in 1933.
